explanation: Map each subset S of [M] to (sum_{j in S} v_j, |S|). The image lies in [-MB, MB]^d x {0..M}, a set of size (2MB+1)^d (M+1) < 2^M, so two distinct subsets S, S' collide (pigeonhole). alpha = 1_S - 1_{S'} is nonzero, has entries in {-1,0,1}, coefficient sum |S| - |S'| = 0, and sum alpha_j v_j = 0.
